name: Create a Task in Attio
description: Creates a task in Attio CRM, optionally linked to a person or company record and assigned to a workspace member.

deadlineAt.description: Deadline in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2025-06-01T00:00:00.000Z'), or null

assigneeEmail.description: Email of the workspace member to assign the task to

linkedRecordId.description: UUID of the record to link to the task

steps.name: Create the task via Attio API
